A '''stormtrooper''' of [[Joker Squad]] was on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in [[137 ABY]], exploring the ruins of the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]]. At least four other Jokers were there. Along with [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Orland]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] searched the jungle outside of the temple. After the Jokers found nothing and reported a fruitless search to their superiors, [[Darth Stryfe]] ordered an [[Destruction of Ossus Jedi Academy|orbital bombardment]] anyway.

==Behind the scenes==
Five [[Trooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in total are shown exploring the ruins in the [[Legacy (2006) 17|seventeenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. One issue [[Legacy (2006) 16|previously]], three are shown, with one of them going unnamed. It is possible that said unnamed trooper is the character described in this article.
